For Advanced Tailscale SSH, is check mode available on the Personal plan? What about non-default check mode lengths?

Check mode itself is available for all plans, including the Personal plan. [To change the check mode length from the default value](https://example.com/checkperiod), a Premium or Enterprise plan is required.
